evidence: The crystallinity of the SrF2 film is similar to that of zinc sulfide deposited by ALD 1 whereas zinc and calcium fluoride are much poorer in this respect. The main reflection in the ZnF2 sample is [011]. In futile structure this surface contains only one type of atom. Therefore it seems that the growing crystal facet tends to form complete layers of ions. The main diffraction peak of SrF2 is [111] on which surface both ions are exposed in fluorite structure. This same orientation has been observed to dominate also in evaporated films on glass. 3~ In alkaline earth fluorides the surface energy density of this interface is particularly low 31 and it is the natural cleavage plane. In CaF2 the [220] peak is also strong while in SrF2 it is barely visible. Evaporated CaF2 has been reported to have a random orientation on silicon oxide at high temperatures) 2
